package_info.why_malicious: No specific malicious package or code is described in this report excerpt. The text is a summary and analysis of the 2024 Verizon Data Breach Investigations Report (DBIR), focusing on the rising risk of software supply chain attacks and the need for improved vendor security practices. It does not provide details about any particular malicious package or code sample.

behavioral_signatures: Increased breaches linked to third-party software development organizations
Exploitation of vulnerabilities in third-party and open-source software
Attacks leveraging compromised development pipelines (e.g., SolarWinds, 3CX)
file_indicators: No specific file indicators provided in the report summary
network_indicators: No specific network indicators provided in the report summary
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for anomalous activity in software supply chain components, such as unexpected changes in dependencies, unauthorized access to build pipelines, and exploitation of known vulnerabilities in third-party software. Implement vendor risk assessments and require software bills of materials (SBOMs) to improve transparency. Use threat intelligence to track emerging supply chain threats and prioritize patching of critical vulnerabilities.
